name: s81hd_tile_f-s81hd_tile_f-COMMIT
purpose: S81-HEAD (release head die): ot_s81hd_tile to closure (TT setup / FF hold / DRC 0 + native audit).

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_s81hd_tile #(.IOREG(1)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/common/ot_prefix.sv rtl/v41rom/ot_v41_fadd.sv rtl/v41rom/ot_v41_bmul2.sv rtl/v41rom/ot_dsrom_bmul3.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_rom_4096x274_m8/ot_rom_4096x274_m8_bb.v rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_head/ot_s81hd_elem.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_head/ot_s81hd_bundle.sv rtl/dsrom_sys/s81_head/ot_s81hd_tile.sv && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.045 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/s81hd_tile_f/signoff_ffrepair.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/s81hd_tile_f/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/s81hd_tile_f --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_s81hd_tile --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros_v2/ot_rom_4096x274_m8 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: S81-HEAD HD-TILE 10-21 FALLBACK: new tile ot_s81hd_tile (SPEC v1 4e30e8f3a section 1: LM-head array tile, 253 a die) = census-safe bundle copy ot_s81hd_bundle (5 elements, 10 ROM4096, 128 rows; IOREG 1, SAFE 1) on bus B (565 b) with the chain-best merge.  Outline 734.4 x 734.4: each element's ROM pair is one abutted N-S stack (ROM pins sit on the W / E faces, lowest 14 um, M4; stack pin ends face the band): N stacks A0 / B / A1 at x 86.4 / 302.4 / 518.4 (y 563.76), S stacks A2 / A3 at x 172.8 / 432 (y 43.2); one full-width std-cell band y 169.1..563.76 plus the column channels; i on W, o on E, straps / ck / rst_n on W.
